```{r}
pacman::p_load(here, cmdstanr, tidyverse, posterior, bayesplot)
```

```{r}
#Make list of files to loop through


wba_fits <- list.files(
  here("scenario_data"),
  pattern = "^wba_model.*\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

pba_fits <- list.files(
  here("scenario_data"),
  pattern = "^pba_model.*\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
i <- 1

for (file in wba_fits) {
  
  fit <- readRDS(file)
  
  # Diagnostics summary
  print(fit$diagnostic_summary())
  
  # Trace plots
  print(mcmc_trace(fit$draws(), pars = "kappa"))
  print(mcmc_trace(fit$draws(), pars = "rho"))
  
  # Rank plots
  print(mcmc_rank_overlay(fit$draws(), pars = "kappa"))
  print(mcmc_rank_overlay(fit$draws(), pars = "rho"))
  
  # Summary table (saved separately)
  fit_summary <- fit$summary(c("kappa", "rho"))
  
  assign(paste0("wba_summary_", i), fit_summary, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  i <- i + 1
}
```

```{r}

i <- 1

for (file in pba_fits) {
  
  fit <- readRDS(file)
  
  # Diagnostics summary
  print(fit$diagnostic_summary())
  
  # Trace plots
  print(mcmc_trace(fit$draws(), pars = "p"))

  # Rank plots
  print(mcmc_rank_overlay(fit$draws(), pars = "p"))
  
  # Summary table
  fit_summary <- fit$summary(c("p"))
  
  assign(paste0("pba_summary_", i), fit_summary, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  i <- i + 1

}
```

```{r}
fit$diagnostic_summary()
```

#For empirical fits 

```{r}
#WBA 
draws_list <- readRDS(here("models_fit_to_data", "wba_empirical_draws.rds"))

summaries <- list()

for (id in names(draws_list)) {
  draws <- draws_list[[id]]
  summaries[[id]] <- summarise_draws(draws, "mean", "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") %>%
    filter(variable %in% c("rho", "kappa"))
}

summary_df <- bind_rows(summaries, .id = "participant_id")

cat("\n── WBA Empirical Summary Ranges ────────────────\n")
summary_df %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    rhat_min = min(rhat,     na.rm = TRUE),
    rhat_max = max(rhat,     na.rm = TRUE),
    ess_min  = min(ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    ess_max  = max(ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print()
```

